document.title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (Chapter IVA)
document.authority: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) & Ministry of Ayush

sections.section_title: Prohibition of Manufacture and Sale of Certain Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani Drugs
sections.content: Section 33EEB: No person shall manufacture for sale or distribution any Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani drug except under, and in accordance with the conditions of, a license issued for such purpose by the Licensing Authority prescribed under Chapter IVA.

sections.section_title: Application of Chapter IVA to Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani Drugs
sections.content: Section 33A: This Chapter applies exclusively to Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani drugs specified in the First Schedule, including classical preparations described in authoritative books specified therein.
